The commonly used electrolyte was prepared with 1.0 M lithium bis- (triﬂuoromethanesulfonyl)imide and 0.2 M lithium nitrate dissolved in DME and DOL (1:1 ratio by volume), which is used as a blank electrolyte of the Li−S battery.
